subject: Artifact transfer protocol and custody checklist (GRCWorks integration)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@grcworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Artifact transfer protocol and custody checklist (GRCWorks integration)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the intro — happy to get the evidence transfer lined up so your security and sales teams can complete the integration checklist. Attached are two files to start: an evidence schema (grcworks_evidence_schema_v1.xlsx) and our standard transfer checklist (transfer_checklist.pdf).

High level: we typically do a locked, auditable transfer to an SFTP endpoint with a manifest and per-file checksums. For higher-sensitivity customers we can escrow artifacts with a neutral custodian and rotate keys post-transfer.

Questions we wanted to confirm before we schedule the push:
- Preferred transfer protocol (SFTP vs temporary S3 bucket with presigned URLs)
- Retention window for inbound artifacts (how long Redwood will keep copies)
- Required access roles from Redwood (who will have read access once transferred)

If it helps, I can set up a 30-min sync with our ops engineer (from StratumSec for pen-test artifacts) and your security lead this week.

Attachments: grcworks_evidence_schema_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), transfer_checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Partnerships — GRCWorks
 elena@grcworks.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@grcworks.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact transfer protocol and custody checklist (GRCWorks integration)

Elena — thanks for the files and the clear checklist. A few notes from our side: 

1) Protocol: Redwood prefers SFTP with key-based auth for partner pushes by default. We can accept a presigned S3 object if you need it, but SFTP is simpler for our ops reviewers.
2) Retention: For initial onboarding, requesting 90 day retention for artifacts is acceptable; for production we prefer 30 days unless there is a contractual reason to retain longer. Can you confirm you can keep the source copy for 180 days on your side?
3) Access & roles: Please provide a list of usernames/emails who will upload and the public key(s) they will use. We will create a read-only service account on our side and rotate credentials after ingestion.

We should also lock the transfer window and confirm custody handoff wording for our compliance logs (we track MD5/SHA256 per file and a manifest). If possible, include checksums in the manifest.

Can we schedule a 30-minute handoff tomorrow (Nov 31 is not real — pick Dec 1) — sorry, meant Dec 1 (Monday) 14:00 PST? Vanessa and Marissa are cc'd to help coordinate procurement/PO and legal steps.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partnerships (Security Integrations)
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@grcworks.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact transfer protocol and custody checklist (GRCWorks integration)

Hi Rishi, Vanessa —

Thanks, that plan works. Quick answers below and a small change to the proposed schedule:

- Protocol: We will push via SFTP to your endpoint. Host: sftp.grcworks.com (we will open the push from our cluster). Fingerprint: SHA256:4c:9b:ab:...
- Retention: GRCWorks will retain original artifacts for 180 days; we will mark copies as "handoff" and include expiry in the manifest metadata.
- Access list: Uploads will be performed by ops@grcworks.com and by StratumSec for penetration-test artifacts (ops@stratumsec.io). We will provide the public keys in a separate secure message.

Operational notes:
- We will provide a CSV manifest (attached: transfer_manifest.csv) with filename, size, sha256, and a category tag (pen-test, config, logs). Please include the manifest checksum in your ingestion audit.
- We require a signed data processing addendum (DPA) and a short transfer statement (two-paragraph custody wording) before the push. I'll send the DocuSign link for the DPA now.
- Proposed transfer window: Tue, Dec 2, 02:00–04:00 UTC (this aligns with our offshore ops). If Redwood needs a different window please propose.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/transactions/detail/abc123-gw

Attachments: transfer_manifest.csv

Happy to jump on the sync at Mon 14:00 PST if you'd still like — otherwise we can do a quick ops-only sync on Tue morning to finalize keys.

Best,
Elena
Partnerships — GRCWorks

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@grcworks.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 12:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact transfer protocol and custody checklist (GRCWorks integration)

Elena — quick note from procurement/legal: we need a brief PO that references the transfer scope and a signed DPA before we accept inbound artifacts. I can generate the PO once the DPA is executed (I reviewed the DocuSign link).

Two asks for the DPA: please confirm the subprocessor list (if any) and whether StratumSec will retain copies after they upload (we prefer they do not keep long-term copies unless agreed). Also please copy a billing contact for invoicing (we will attach the PO to the invoice).

Once the DPA is signed, can you send the upload public keys in an encrypted channel (we can accept a GPG payload or transfer via the SFTP control channel)? We'll rotate and provision the keys on our side and issue temporary credentials for ingestion.

Thanks — will standby to issue PO and route to accounts payable.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Procurement & Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@grcworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Artifact transfer protocol and custody checklist (GRCWorks integration)

All — confirming next steps and timeline. 

- DocuSign DPA shows as signed (I see Elena's signature). Marissa, please generate PO PART-2025-0789 and attach to the incoming invoice.
- Transfer window set: Wed, Dec 3 02:00–04:00 UTC. Ops teams to push during that window.
- Elena: please deliver the upload public keys to Marissa via GPG or the secure channel and post the manifest file to the SFTP drop once uploads complete. We'll verify the manifest checksums and ingest.
- We will create an evidence bucket on our Private intake (redwood-evidence-ingest) and map the files to our audit trail. Retention on our side will be 30 days by default; we will mark the handoff event in the audit log with the manifest hash.

Attachments we have on record: grcworks_evidence_schema_v1.xlsx, transfer_checklist.pdf, transfer_manifest.csv.

Thanks everyone — Vanessa will monitor the transfer window and escalate to infra if anything fails.

Rishi
Head of Partnerships (Security Integrations)
Redwood Inference
